summary: Foundation, homepage, astrology, services, pooja data (16 poojas + 10 homas, slugs valid), contact and talk-to-us look correct per FEAT evidence, and every FEAT records a successful build. However, a grep of src/ shows blogs/[slug]/page.tsx was never restyled and still uses the removed maroon/saffron/ivory/charcoal classes. These tokens no longer exist in the theme, so that page renders unstyled with the old design. This contradicts FEAT-004's claim of a clean final scan. Blog metadata still carries old Gokarna branding.

Then re-run the grep for maroon|saffron|ivory|charcoal across src/ and fix any other hits. The grep output was truncated, so other files may also be affected.

src/app/blogs/layout.tsx and src/app/blogs/[slug]/layout.tsx metadata and openGraph still say 'Gokarna Sarva Poojas' and Gokarna heritage. Update them to R. Anand branding. The share text in blogs/[slug]/page.tsx (shareText) also says '— Gokarna Sarva Poojas'.

Re-verify with a final grep that no maroon/saffron/ivory/charcoal class names or old hex values remain anywhere in src/, then record the real result. FEAT-004's 'zero remaining' finding is inaccurate.
